note: Small, mostly seasonal campground (100 sites on 24 acres) around a catch-and-release pond near East Springfield, a few minutes from Lake Erie and Erie Bluffs State Park; in-ground pool, game room, camp store. 2026 overnight rates: RV site with electric and water $50 ($60 holiday), tent site $45, for 2 adults + 2 children; two-night minimum on the three summer holidays. Reservations by phone. Season May 1 - early October. Google 4.2 over 55 reviews (RV Life lists it unrated). --Claude
summary: Confirmed the 2026 $50 ($60 holiday) RV rate, electric+water sites. Added 100 sites (mostly seasonal), season May 1 - Oct 4, phone reservations, holiday 2-night minimum, 72-hour cancellation. Not stated: electric amperage, sewer, site lengths, showers/dump.
flags: Criteria (mostly seasonal): the operator's home page calls it 'a 24 acre, 100 site, mostly seasonal campground'; it does sell nightly RV sites ($50 for 2 adults + 2 children, by phone), and seasonal rates are $2,250 part-time / $2,650 full-time. The base sits exactly at the US$50 private gate. A human should apply the five-test rule for long-stay parks.
